blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Some100 witnesses are expected to testify in the trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte before the International Criminal Court (ICC) starting Nov. 30, its spokesperson Oriane Huber Maillet said on Tuesday. Duterte, who is facing three counts of alleged crimes against humanity stemming from incidents during his term as Davao City mayor and Philippine president, will be tried in the ICC some 20 months after his arrest on March 12, 2025.
